Title: Data Migration Assistant support for Cassandra to Azure Cosmos DB assessment

Body.Content:
Now in preview, the Data Migration Assistant provides support to help customers with migrating data from Cassandra to Azure Cosmos DB. Running the Data Migration Assistant on Cassandra data detects potential compatibility and feature parity issues that can impact functionality in target Azure Cosmos DB datasets.

 

 

Learn more
